test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement.

**Statement: **

Plastic is only one of the pollutants to the environment.

**Conclusions: **

I. Do not curb the use of plastic.

II. Impose a complete ban on plastic.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusion I and II follow.

solution:
• Do not curb the use of plastic. - This is a course of action and not a conclusion. Therefore, it does not follow.
 
• Impose a complete ban on plastic. - This is a course of action and not a conclusion. Therefore, it does not follow.
